shadyGoods.name: Debt-Marker Chalk
shadyGoods.description: A stub of gray chalk Marrow's collectors use to mark doors without alarming honest folk.
shadyGoods.passive: When you tail a creature that passed a chalk mark you made within the past hour, you gain a +2 bonus to your next Dexterity (Stealth) check.

shadyGoods.name: Velvet Pouch of Quiet Coins
shadyGoods.description: A lined pouch that muffles coin clatter—popular with gamblers and pickpockets alike.
shadyGoods.passive: You have advantage on your next Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check made to palm, plant, or swap a coin-sized object.

shadyGoods.name: Forged Release Stub
shadyGoods.description: A convincingly stamped bail chit copied from the magistrate's outer office.
shadyGoods.passive: Within the next hour, you gain a +1 bonus to your next Charisma (Deception) check made while posing as a courier, clerk, or debt collector.
